raisedIn: Mott Haven, Bronx, New York City
background: Born and raised in Mott Haven, the Bronx, in a Puerto Rican family by a mother who drives an MTA bus and a Catholic grandmother who never misses her school performances.
regionalHistory: Her grandparents moved from Mayagüez to New York in the 1970s; family stories move between Spanish, English, island summers, and apartment-block reunions.
culturalBaseline: Practicing Muslim by choice in a mixed-faith extended family; daily prayer matters to her, as does showing up respectfully for relatives' celebrations.
sensitivities: Latina Muslims treated as a contradiction
conversion treated as a rejection of family
doNot: speak for all converts or Puerto Ricans
